project_type: Next.js 16 App Router static site with React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v4
test_framework: No test framework configured - lint only
build_command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && npm run build
test_command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && npm run lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0. 2. Run npm run lint and confirm no errors.
setup_instructions: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22 && npm install
environment_constraints: Node.js 22 via nvm. OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: Use conventional commits. Each commit must leave the build passing. Use Tailwind CSS utility classes and semantic HTML per steering file.
key_patterns: Pages use server components with Metadata exports. Client components live in app/components/ and use 'use client' directive. Dark-first theme with CSS variables. Glass morphism utility class. Framer-motion for animations in client components. Path alias @/* configured in tsconfig.
directory_structure: app/ - pages (about/, features/, etc. each with page.tsx), app/components/ - shared components, app/lib/ - utilities, public/ - static assets
